read_ply_file: read a PLY file from disk using PlyData.read and access element data by name
write_ply_file: write PLY data to a file using PlyData.write with text or binary format
describe_ply_element: construct a PlyElement from a numpy structured array using PlyElement.describe
create_ply_data: create a PlyData object from PlyElement instances with specified byte order and comments
make2d_array: convert an array of arrays into a 2D numpy array using make2d
